_comment: Decisions for making the crawled copy self-contained. 'hosts' are the sites being rewritten: the prepared copy the crawl came from, and the production domain (randyfay.com), which is this site. Anything the original already had dead or restricted is kept as it was (handled before these rules). See test/playwright/kit/scripts/rewrite-static.mjs.

rules.name: comment permalinks point at the comment on this archive's page
login, profile, logout and search links are dynamic: link removed, text kept
feed-discovery <link> tags removed (a feed is a dynamic feature the static copy does not have)
